players_meta.rates_from: EWMA of prior games (half-life 10 games), shrunk to the position prior for small samples, adjusted by the opponent's trailing allowed rates and expected pace
players_meta.minutes_from: gradient-boosted minutes model (trailing minutes, start share, rest, schedule, expected margin, absent teammates), reconciled to 240 team minutes
players_meta.simulation: attempts ~ Poisson, makes ~ Binomial, shared minutes and pace draws; combos and fantasy computed per simulation
players_meta.availability_adjusted: conditional mean x P(play); a DNP voids a prop but scores zero in fantasy
players_meta.lineups_note: court placement is illustrative; positions are ESPN's listed positions

grades.timeframe: 2025-26 full season (last finished season; the new season has no games yet)

meta.coverage: box scores only (no lineup/on-off data yet)
meta.defence: not graded: lineup on/off data not yet collected

components.production: per-36 box production incl. TS%, shrunk to the position mean by games played
components.role: minutes per game and start share
components.form: last-10 production per 36 minus the season figure
components.impact: plus-minus per 36 relative to the team's margin (coarse on-court proxy, not a defence grade)

validation.reading: Spearman rank correlation with per-game production over the next 10 games, at three checkpoints per season; the grade is labelled a descriptive summary regardless, since this checks ranking of production, not prop or fantasy outcomes

grades.definition: Snap Grade is a percentile rank among the comparison group of a weighted, shrunk box-production summary; descriptive, not a probability

fantasy.note: basketball scoring only; NFL PPR settings are never applied here

team_backtest.market_comparison: none: no historical NBA closing lines are held; forward collection only

player_backtest.market_comparison: none: no historical NBA prop lines are held; forward collection only

grade_validation.reading: Spearman rank correlation with per-game production over the next 10 games, at three checkpoints per season; the grade is labelled a descriptive summary regardless, since this checks ranking of production, not prop or fantasy outcomes

props.note: graded against the actual stat once box scores land; EV realised only on real quotes

results.market_note: No historical NBA lines are held, so no real-market backtest is claimed. Lines are collected forward from the first fetch; the market comparison fills in as games settle.
